title: Specs Concern Document Schema
description: One concern of a component, as written by a run with splitConcerns. Each concern has its own shape, requiring what it carries and permitting nothing else. Component-level definitions are referenced from component.schema.json rather than restated. (ADR-091)

SpecApiDocument.description: The api concern of a component: what it is and what it takes — title, anatomy and props. Written as api.yaml by a run with splitConcerns. (ADR-091)

metadata.description: Must state `concern: api`. This is what identifies the document, and what separates it from the other concerns in root.schema.json.

anatomy.description: The elements that comprise the component, corresponding largely to Figma layers

props.description: Configurable properties that control component behavior and appearance

invalidPropCombinations.description: Non-default prop values that when used in combination result in an invalid component state, such as a component being set to disabled and hover simultaneously

subcomponents.description: This document's slice of each subcomponent, keyed by subcomponent name.

SpecVariantsDocument.description: The variants concern of a component: the default appearance and every variant override. Written as variants.yaml by a run with splitConcerns. (ADR-091)

metadata.description: Must state `concern: variants`. This is what identifies the document, and what separates it from the other concerns in root.schema.json.

default.description: The base variant configuration that's both the component default display as well as the foundation for all other variants

variants.description: The styling, layout, and configuration of nested instances based on a cmoponent configuration

subcomponents.description: This document's slice of each subcomponent, keyed by subcomponent name.

SpecExamplesDocument.description: The examples concern of a component: documented usages, the content they compose, and the image registry those reference. Written as examples.yaml when a component has any. (ADR-091)

metadata.description: Must state `concern: examples`. This is what identifies the document, and what separates it from the other concerns in root.schema.json.

slotContentExamples.description: Named slot-content examples for this component (ADR-047). Each entry is a SlotContent — a flat anatomy+elements+layout triplet usable as a named slot fill. Referenced via SlotContentRef from SlotBinding.examples and from Element.propConfigurations slot-prop entries (ADR-049). specs-from-figma de-duplicates entries by structural equality.

instanceExamples.description: Named instance examples (documented usages) for this component.

images.description: Registry of image data referenced by backgroundImage fills, ImageBinding examples, and ImageProp defaults. De-duplicated so each distinct image is stored once (ADR-063).

subcomponents.description: This document's slice of each subcomponent, keyed by subcomponent name.

SpecApiSubcomponent.description: A subcomponent's api slice: what it is and what it takes. (ADR-091)

source.description: Figma source identity for this subcomponent's node.

subcomponents.description: Nested subcomponents, sliced by the same concern.
